heading.text: Page classification — Auto Classify sorts what the rules miss

about.text:
Drawn from the real screens' code with More Handles' own pages and clicks (16 Oct 2026).

New on these boards: the Auto Classify button; its progress line in the notice, with a progress bar under it (proposed 16 Oct, board 2); By Auto Classify: sure / fairly sure under How it's set; Sorted by Auto Classify in the Classification chip; the Description box on a group's page.

Board 2: the groups are the ones Auto Classify is expected to pick for More Handles' busiest unclassified pages.

Board 3: the 405 unclassified pages with 'hinge' in their address are counted as sorted by Auto Classify, beside the 163 the rule catches.
